（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE JUNCTA JUVANT）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Shanghai Municipal Council.
651 BQ
19/10/16. A.N.

October 17th 1918

Sir,
Owing to the minor disturbances recently created by the destitute rebels, the Police and troops in the City and in the vicinity of the Arsenal have received instructions to exercise extra vigilance when on patrol at night.
General Lu of Woosung visited the Arsenal yesterday yesterday and had tiffin with General Yang.
On the 16th inst the destitute rebels left the teashops which they had been frequenting near the West Gate and again gathered at the Zee Oen 全少 teashop, Rue Kraetzer in Frenchtown. So far they are quite quiet and orderly but they declare that if assistance is not forthcoming by the 18th inst they will go round the shops and seize food to satisfy their hunger.
（批：Evidence re Zaily 17-11-18 Off）
Yu Ya Ching 虞洽卿 has called a meeting for to-day the 17th inst at 2 p.m. at the Chamber of Commerce to discuss the question of raising more funds for repatriation purposes.
It is announced that the repatriation funds will be distributed on the 21st, 22nd and 23rd instants at a building near the Hunan Guild, Kao Chong Miao 高昌庙. The rebels however have so far received no notification to the above effect
Ling Sz Foong 林世丰 General Chang Hsun's detective returned to Shanghai on the 16th inst and took up his old quarters at No.1 Ling Yung Road.
There are no further developments in the painters dispute which shows signs of dying out for lack of interest and support.
（批：K 12/10）

Your Obedient Servant,
[Signature]
Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

编号
（印章：上海工部局警务处 同心协力）
警务处，
（侦探股。）

上海工部局。
651 BQ
19/10/16. A.N.

1918年10月17日

先生：

鉴于近期由贫困叛乱分子引发的轻微骚乱，市区及兵工厂附近的警察和部队已接到指令，在夜间巡逻时须格外警惕。

吴淞的卢将军昨日访问了兵工厂，并与杨将军共进午餐。

本月16日，那些贫困叛乱分子离开了他们经常光顾的西门附近茶馆，再次聚集在法租界克勒策路（Rue Kraetzer）的“全少”茶馆。目前他们相当安静且守秩序，但他们声称，如果到本月18日仍得不到援助，他们将挨家挨户搜查店铺，夺取食物以充饥。
（批注：关于Zaily的证据 18年11月17日 结案）

虞洽卿已召集于今日（本月17日）下午2时在商会开会，讨论筹集更多资金用于遣返事宜的问题。

据宣布，遣返资金将于本月21日、22日和23日在高昌庙附近的湖南会馆旁的一座建筑内分发。然而，叛乱分子迄今未收到上述通知。

张勋将军的侦探林世丰于本月16日返回上海，并重新入住灵永路1号的旧寓所。

油漆工纠纷没有进一步进展，该纠纷因缺乏关注和支持而显现出逐渐平息迹象。
（批注：K 10月12日）

您顺从的仆人，
[签名]
总探长。

警务处总监上尉
